tests.title: Minimum-spend promo code created in the CRM discounts an eShop basket that reaches the minimum
tests.goal: A new "Get $Y off upon spending over $X with discount code" promotion works on the eShop as soon as it is saved.
preconditions: Product C is sold on the eShop at HKD 700.00 (or another product whose price is used as X)
data: X = 700, Y = 50, Applied Shop = Online Shop, start = today 00:00, end = a date next month

steps.text: Log in to the staging CRM and open Promotions > Add Promotion > "Promo Code: Get $Y off upon spending over $X with discount code"
Fill the data above and Save -> Expect: the list shows the promotion as active with "above 700 can enjoy $50 discount"
On the eShop as a guest, add product C (HKD 700.00) to the cart and open checkout
Enter the code and click APPLY

expected.text: "Applied: <code>" with REMOVE is shown
Summary: Sub-total HKD $700.00, Basket Discount "- <promotion name> - HKD $50.00", Total HKD $650.00
Cleanup: remove the cart item; delete the promotion (confirm DELETE) and the list count drops by 1

checks.label: "Applied: <code>" with REMOVE is shown
Summary: Sub-total HKD $700.00, Basket Discount "- <promotion name> - HKD $50.00", Total HKD $650.00
Cleanup: remove the cart item; delete the promotion (confirm DELETE) and the list count drops by 1

notes: Promotion 661 QA1027NQ3T8 (X 700 / Y 750): product C HKD 700.00 -> Applied, discount capped at the sub-total, Total HKD 0.00. Y > X allowed is Q-014.

tests.title: Promo discount is removed when the basket drops below the minimum spend
tests.goal: A minimum-spend code cannot keep its discount after items are removed at checkout.
preconditions: Product C (HKD 700.00) and NAKAJIMA cake (HKD 0.10) are sold on the eShop
data: A minimum-spend promotion created at runtime as in SCRM-098 (X = 700, code `<unique>`)

steps.text: As a guest, add product C and the NAKAJIMA cake to the cart and open checkout (Sub-total HKD $700.10)
Apply the code -> Expect: Basket Discount line shown
Remove product C from the cart with its trash icon

expected.text: "Item remove successfully"; Sub-total HKD $0.10
No Basket Discount line; Total HKD $0.10; the promotion box is empty with APPLY
Cleanup: empty the cart; delete the promotion

checks.label: "Item remove successfully"; Sub-total HKD $0.10
No Basket Discount line; Total HKD $0.10; the promotion box is empty with APPLY
Cleanup: empty the cart; delete the promotion

notes: C + cake 700.10 with the code, then C removed -> discount gone, Total 0.10.

tests.title: Promo code is refused when the basket is below the minimum spend
tests.goal: Customers get a clear message when their basket does not qualify for a minimum-spend code.
preconditions: NAKAJIMA cake (HKD 0.10) is sold on the eShop
data: A minimum-spend promotion created at runtime as in SCRM-098 (X = 700, code `<unique>`)

steps.text: As a guest, add only the NAKAJIMA cake to the cart and open checkout
Enter the code and click APPLY

expected.text: Message "Current shopping cart does not meet the promotion code conditions"
No Basket Discount line; Total stays HKD $0.10
Cleanup: empty the cart; delete the promotion

checks.label: Message "Current shopping cart does not meet the promotion code conditions"
No Basket Discount line; Total stays HKD $0.10
Cleanup: empty the cart; delete the promotion

notes: Cake only -> "Current shopping cart does not meet the promotion code conditions".

tests.title: Expired promo code is refused on the eShop
tests.goal: Ending a promotion in the CRM stops its code from working on the eShop.
preconditions: Product C (HKD 700.00) is sold on the eShop
data: A minimum-spend promotion created at runtime as in SCRM-098 (X = 700, code `<unique>`)

steps.text: In the CRM edit the promotion: start yesterday 00:00, end yesterday 23:00; Save -> Expect: list status "expired"
As a guest add product C to the cart, open checkout, enter the code and click APPLY

expected.text: Message "Promotion code is invalid, expired or exceed the usage limit"
No Basket Discount line; Total equals Sub-total
Cleanup: empty the cart; delete the promotion

checks.label: Message "Promotion code is invalid, expired or exceed the usage limit"
No Basket Discount line; Total equals Sub-total
Cleanup: empty the cart; delete the promotion

notes: After making 661 expired -> "Promotion code is invalid, expired or exceed the usage limit".

tests.title: Promotion save rejects an End Datetime earlier than the Start Datetime
tests.goal: Staff cannot save a promotion whose date window is impossible.
data: Promotion name and code `<unique>`, X = 700, Y = 50, Applied Shop = Online Shop

steps.text: Log in to the staging CRM and open Promotions > Add Promotion > "Promo Code: Get $Y off upon spending over $X with discount code"
Fill the data, type Start Datetime **today 00:00:00** and End Datetime **yesterday 09:00:00**
Click Save

expected.text: A message says the end datetime must be after the start datetime
The page stays on the form and no promotion is added (list count unchanged)

checks.label: A message says the end datetime must be after the start datetime
The page stays on the form and no promotion is added (list count unchanged)

notes: End datetime before start saved silently; listed as expired (BUG-024).

tests.title: Edit a QA promotion, then delete it with confirmation
tests.goal: Promotion edits persist and delete removes only after confirmation.
data: A minimum-spend promotion created at runtime as in SCRM-098 (X = 100, Y = 10, code `<unique>`)

steps.text: Open the promotion's edit (pencil) icon, change X to 700 and Y to 50, Save
Reopen the edit page -> Expect: X 700, Y 50; list details "above 700 can enjoy $50 discount"
Click the trash icon -> Expect: "Are you sure to delete this promotion rule?" with DELETE / CANCEL
Click CANCEL -> Expect: the promotion is still listed
Click the trash icon again and DELETE

expected.text: The promotion is no longer listed and "All Promotions (n)" drops by 1
Its code is refused on the eShop ("Promotion code is invalid, expired or exceed the usage limit")

checks.label: The promotion is no longer listed and "All Promotions (n)" drops by 1
Its code is refused on the eShop ("Promotion code is invalid, expired or exceed the usage limit")

notes: Edit X 700 / Y 750 persisted; delete asks DELETE/CANCEL; Cancel keeps it; DELETE -> 44 -> 43. Deleted edit URL shows a bare 500 (risk).

tests.title: Partial receive moves stock only for the received transfer row
tests.goal: Receiving one row of a multi-product transfer moves only that product and marks the transfer Partial Received.
preconditions: Office has available stock of product test 2 and C
data: Transfer number `<unique>` (QA-TO-<unique>), Office -> TaiPo Warehouse, product test 2 x1 and C x1

steps.text: Inventory > Transfer Orders > Add Transfer Order with the data; Submit > Confirm -> Expect: Pending, Office product test 2 available -1
Open the transfer, click Transfer > OK -> Expect: In-transit, Office product test 2 stock -1
Turn on only the product test 2 row toggle, click Receive > OK

expected.text: Status Partial Received; product test 2 Receive Qty 1, TaiPo stock and available +1
C Receive Qty 0; TaiPo C unchanged
Receive is still offered for the remaining row
Cleanup: receive the C row (status Received)

checks.label: Status Partial Received; product test 2 Receive Qty 1, TaiPo stock and available +1
C Receive Qty 0; TaiPo C unchanged
Receive is still offered for the remaining row
Cleanup: receive the C row (status Received)

notes: Transfer 311 QA-TO-mvqodhe9: only product test 2 received -> Partial Received, TaiPo 9/8 -> 10/9, C unchanged. Q-016 for closing the rest.

tests.title: Cancelling an In-transit transfer returns the stock to the source warehouse
tests.goal: A shipped transfer can be cancelled and the source warehouse gets all its stock back.
preconditions: Office has available stock of product test 2
data: Transfer number `<unique>` (QA-TO-<unique>), Office -> TaiPo Warehouse, product test 2 x1

steps.text: Add Transfer Order with the data; Submit > Confirm (Pending); note Office stock / available (S / A)
Transfer > OK -> Expect: In-transit, Office S-1 / A-1
Cancel Transfer > OK -> Expect: status Pending, Office S / A-1
Cancel Transfer Orders > OK

expected.text: Status Canceled; Office back to S / A; TaiPo unchanged
Inventory History lists IN_TRANSIT, CANCEL_TRANSFER and CANCEL_TRANSFER_ORDER for the transfer number
Transfer time is empty or shows the real shipping time (not the cancel time)

checks.label: Status Canceled; Office back to S / A; TaiPo unchanged
Inventory History lists IN_TRANSIT, CANCEL_TRANSFER and CANCEL_TRANSFER_ORDER for the transfer number
Transfer time is empty or shows the real shipping time (not the cancel time)

notes: Transfer 312 QA-TO-mvqoiwwt: Canceled, Office 43/43 restored, history complete. Transfer time 20:46:38 = the cancel time (BUG-025). Screenshot taken 2026-10-28 from the same transfer.
Recorded 2026-10-28 for the 2026-10-27 evening exploration (promotions, transfers).
